candidate_sentence_map.S1: Trophy Games experienced a strong period of financial growth and operational scaling during fiscal year 2025, driven primarily by the successful expansion of its core Transport Game Series.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Total revenue for the year increased by 40 percent to DKK 126,523 thousand, compared with DKK 90,070 thousand in the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Profitability also improved significantly, with earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization rising by 26 percent to DKK 31,117 thousand, up from DKK 24,671 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Profit before tax more than doubled, increasing by 109 percent to DKK 19,013 thousand compared with DKK 9,068 thousand, resulting in an improved EBT margin of 15 percent.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Net profit for the year reached DKK 12,539 thousand compared with DKK 7,471 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: The primary driver was the rapid scaling of the company's transport and management portfolio.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Airline Manager, Truck Manager, and Farm Manager collectively generated 67 percent of total revenue in 2025, while smaller titles declined as marketing resources were reallocated.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Operational results were bolstered by in-app advertising optimisation initiated late in the third quarter.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: In-app advertising revenue doubled to DKK 18,476 thousand and improved cost efficiency.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: The company maintained a solid financial position at year-end, with total assets of DKK 84,597 thousand and total equity of DKK 66,120 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Trophy Games carried no interest-bearing external debt.

evaluation.label: Neutral/Mixed
evaluation.justification: K1 is fully present with revenue, EBITDA, and EBT growth figures. K2 is partially present as it mentions the 'Big 3' titles generating 67% of revenue but omits Truck Manager's specific growth trajectory and Farm Manager's pre-registrations. K3 is fully present with ad revenue doubling and cost efficiency improvements. K4 is missing entirely - no 2026 guidance or strategic focus details appear. K5 is partially present with equity and debt information but lacks the solvency ratio and share buy-back program details. K6 is missing entirely - there is no mention of framework-driven development strategy or reusable codebases. The summary captures some high-importance elements but omits several core components, resulting in a mixed coverage level.
